description: This line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small," illustrates the evolution of Word Error Rate (WER) across training epochs for four different model configurations during fine-tuning. The x-axis represents the training epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5 on a linear scale, with tick labels spaced at 2.5-unit intervals. The plot contains four distinct lines: the "small AdaLoRA_int4" line is orange with square markers and a solid line; the "small AdaLoRA_int8" line is orange with square markers and a dashed line; the "small int4" line is orange with circular markers and a solid line; and the "small int8" line is orange with circular markers and a dashed line. The "small AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at a WER of approximately 35.5 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of 43.0 at epoch 1, then declines to approximately 38.0 at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line starts at approximately 35.5 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of 43.0 at epoch 1, then declines to approximately 37.5 at epoch 6. The "small int4" line remains relatively stable, starting at approximately 30.5 at epoch 0 and ending at approximately 35.5 at epoch 6. The "small int8" line starts at approximately 30.5 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of 35.5 at epoch 1, then declines to approximately 32.5 at epoch 6.
